policy: Every reading is a frozen blood_constraints row function and every verdict its frozen passes(), primary reading only. A row whose frozen function raises (for instance because the blood reading's own haemodynamics stop) is UNREADABLE, with its message. A candidate is REJECTED when a readable constraint fails in either case, SURVIVES when every constraint is readable and met in both cases, and is UNREADABLE otherwise; UNREADABLE is reported apart and is never counted as a faculty bound. The cross-checks of blood_constraints.tables (Hb independent of the haemodynamics; the retained crystalloid independent of the bleeding, B0 and refill) are run on every extended row and any failure is reported as a contradiction. FD-BLD-03 is counted as a diagnostic only.
rule: For each open dimension, take its three explored values. If they have a constant difference and not a constant ratio, continue by that difference; if a constant ratio and not a constant difference, by that ratio; otherwise the continuation is AMBIGUOUS and the dimension is not extended. Continue one and two steps beyond the open edge only. A point outside the parameter's domain is dropped, not moved. The rule reads only the explored values, never a count.
